name: iam:PassRole + glue:UpdateJob + glue:CreateTrigger
description: Update an existing Glue job to use a privileged role and malicious script, then create a scheduled trigger with --start-on-creation to execute the job automatically. Unlike glue:CreateJob which creates new resources, this path modifies existing infrastructure for stealth, and the scheduled trigger provides persistence — it re-executes the job every minute, re-granting access even after manual remediation attempts.
author: Seth Art

required.description: Must be able to pass a role to glue.amazonaws.com
Must be able to update existing Glue job configurations
Must be able to create Glue triggers with --start-on-creation flag

additional.description: Retrieve current job configuration before modification
Discover existing Glue jobs that can be modified
Monitor trigger state and activation status
List job runs to track execution history
Discover available privileged roles to pass

admin: An existing Glue job must be present in the environment that can be modified
IAM role with administrative permissions and trust policy allowing glue.amazonaws.com
lateral: An existing Glue job that can be modified
S3 bucket accessible to the victim account containing the Glue script (attacker account auto-provisions this)

references.title: Rhino Security Labs - CloudGoat Glue privesc Walkthrough

techniques: T1565.001 - Data Manipulation: Stored Data Manipulation

options.name: ROLE_ARN
options.description: Target IAM role ARN to pass to the Glue job (must trust glue.amazonaws.com)

options.name: JOB_NAME
options.description: Name of the existing Glue job to update (required; use 'discover JOB_NAME' to list available jobs)

options.name: SCRIPT_S3_URI
options.description: S3 URI of the Glue script (e.g., s3://bucket/script.py). Auto-provisioned if attacker identity is set.

options.name: REGION
options.description: AWS region for Glue job and trigger operations

options.name: CLEANUP
options.description: Stop and delete the trigger and restore the job to its original configuration after the first run completes
